household.title: Household members
household.subtitle: People who share this household's inventory, plans, and history.
household.profileHint: For family members who don't use the app (a toddler, for example). They get a profile only — no account — and you manage it for them.
household.leaveConfirm: Leave {{name}}? You will lose access to its inventory, plans, and history.
household.inviteHint: Share this code with someone you live with. It expires in 7 days.
household.inviteNone: No active invite code. Generate one to invite someone.
household.inviteTargetHint: The first person to redeem this code joins as this member — their account is linked to this profile, keeping its name, birth date, and documents.
household.inviteInvalidTarget: Invite target must be a member without an account in this household.
household.joinHint: Got a code from your household? Enter it here.
household.joinAlready: You are already a member of {{name}}.
household.createHint: A second household — e.g. for another home. It starts empty and does not switch your active one.
household.lastOwnerWarning: As the last owner you cannot leave or be removed until another owner exists.
household.lastOwnerRemoveBlocked: A household must keep at least one owner.
household.onlyOwners: Only household owners can do that
household.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
household.joinConflict: This invite's profile has already been linked to another account.

tasks.mineSubtitle: What's assigned to you — mark it done when finished.
tasks.recurringHint: Recurring — completing it schedules the next occurrence.
tasks.emptyDesc: Assign chores and errands to family members — they show up here.
tasks.onlyCreatorOwner: Only the task creator or a household owner can do that.
tasks.conflict: That task was already updated — refresh and try again.
tasks.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

calendar.membersHint: The creator always sees the event too.
calendar.emptyDayDesc: Pick another day, or add an event below.

documents.title: Document vault
documents.subtitle: Private family documents — free-text names, multiple files per document — stored securely for this household.
documents.uploadHint: Give it any name, then add one or more files (JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF up to 10 MB each). Only members of this household can ever open them.
documents.listHint: Search by name or filter by family member.
documents.emptyDesc: Upload your kartu keluarga, IDs, or your children's akta lahir to keep them safe in one place.
documents.viewerUnsupported: This file type cannot be previewed — download it instead.
documents.errorTooLarge: File too large. Maximum size is 10 MB.
documents.errorType: Unsupported file type. Accepted: JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF.
documents.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
documents.errorAiNotConfigured: AI provider not configured — set it up in Settings first.
documents.errorOcr: Could not read a date from this file. Try again or type the date manually.
documents.errorSlowDown: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
documents.errorSlowDownRetry: Too many requests. Please try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
documents.errorNoName: Give the document a name first.
documents.errorTooManyFiles: A document can hold at most 20 files.
documents.expiryHint: Optional — when this document expires (passport, insurance, warranty).
documents.remindHint: How many days before expiry it shows as due (1-365).
documents.dueSoonHint: Documents inside their reminder window — renew or replace them in time.
documents.expiryRead: Read {{date}} from {{name}} — check it and save.
documents.errorRemindRange: Reminder window must be between 1 and 365 days.

home.estimateToday: estimated less than a day left
home.allSafeDesc: No items expiring or running out in the next 7 days.
home.recipeDesc: The assistant can find a recipe on recipe websites using what's about to expire. Review before adding anything.

inventory.noMatchDesc: Try different keywords or change the storage location filter.

addReceipt.lead: Take a photo or upload a receipt. AI reads items, quantity, price, and store, then you confirm.
addReceipt.dropHint: or drag an image here. Supports JPG, PNG, or PDF.
addReceipt.scanningDesc: Recognizing items, prices, and store. Just a moment.
addReceipt.stockUpdatedDesc: Remaining items are updated automatically from shopping patterns. No manual tracking needed.

plan.leadNoKey: Connect an API key first, then AI will create a shopping plan from items running low.
plan.lead: AI groups items by store into single trips. Check off what you've bought, the rest is tracked automatically.
plan.bringYourOwnKey: Bring your own AI key, e.g. OpenCode. Once connected, press one button to create a plan.
plan.allBoughtDesc: Stock is updated automatically from the next receipt.
plan.basedOnItems: This plan was created from {{count}} item running low. Ask the assistant to combine into one trip per store.
plan.generatePrompt: Generate a shopping plan from your current stock and purchase history.
plan.basedOnItems_other: This plan was created from {{count}} items running low. Ask the assistant to combine into one trip per store.

prices.lead: Store prices observed from weekly promo brochures. Filter by store, tap a product for its price history.
prices.noMatchDesc: Prices come from the daily brochure scan — try different keywords or check back tomorrow.
prices.listLimit: Showing the first {{limit}} results — refine your search to narrow it down.
prices.promosLead: Current promotions from weekly brochures, grouped by deal type.
prices.promosEmptyDesc: Promotions will appear here after the next brochure scrape.
prices.brochuresLead: The actual brochure pages behind the current prices, grouped by store.
prices.brochuresEmptyDesc: Brochure pages will appear here after the next scrape publishes them.

monitor.lead: Nightly scraper runs on the VPS. Logs live in journald on the box; this screen shows reported outcomes.
monitor.stale: Over a day old — the nightly scrape is not landing
monitor.forbiddenDesc: The scraping monitor is restricted to operator accounts.
monitor.noRunsDesc: The scraper reports each finished live run here — dry-runs never appear.
monitor.needsProxy: needs a Tier-3 proxy — skipped by design until credentials are configured
monitor.auditSummary: Extraction audit — {{count}} pages re-extracted: names {{name}}%, prices {{price}}%, original prices {{original}}%, promos {{promo}}%
monitor.taxonomySummary: Taxonomy {{version}} — classified {{classified}} (cache {{cache}}, rules {{rules}}); low-confidence {{lowConfidence}}, disagreements {{disagreements}} → review

scrape.alreadyRunning: A scrape is already pending or running — one run at a time.
scrape.forbiddenDesc: This page is only available to allowlisted operators.
scrape.lead: Queue an on-demand scrape of the selected stores. The VPS agent picks the command up within seconds and streams the raw scraper output here.
scrape.logTruncated: The head of the log was dropped — this is the tail of the run.
scrape.noCommandsDesc: Triggered scrapes and their full logs appear here.
scrape.waitingForAgent: Waiting for the VPS agent to pick up the command…

aiUsage.lead: AI usage across all users for the selected range. Usage is recorded for analytics only — it never caps a call.
aiUsage.empty: No AI usage in this range
aiUsage.emptyDesc: AI calls appear here as they happen.
aiUsage.forbiddenDesc: This page is only available to admins.

history.patternText: Milk and bread are bought every 7 days from Indomaret. The assistant can remind you before they run out.
history.error: Failed to load history. Try again.
history.emptyDesc: Add a receipt to start tracking your purchases.

settings.providerDesc: Select the AI service you subscribe to.
settings.customModelDesc: Model name the provider should call, e.g. glm-5.3-flash. Receipt scanning requires a vision-capable model.
settings.modelDesc: Model the provider should call. Leave empty to use its default. Receipt scanning requires a vision-capable model.
settings.visionModelDesc: Used for document OCR — reading expiry dates from vault files. Leave empty to use the model above.
settings.thinkingDesc: Higher levels trade speed for deeper reasoning on models that support it. Unsupported models will surface a provider error.
settings.inactiveServer: No key set. AI answers via RumaQ's shared key (20 requests/day). Add your own key for unlimited use.
settings.apiKeyDesc: Stored on your device, used only to call your chosen AI.
settings.apiKeyChangePlaceholder: New key (leave blank to keep existing)
settings.connectionSuccessDesc: AI can create plans and read receipts.
settings.connectionFailedDesc: Check your API key and try again.
settings.inactive: Not connected. Without a key, AI features are disabled but inventory still works.
settings.personalizationDesc: Set how RumaQ speaks to you and the app theme color.
settings.previewPlaceholder: Fill in roles and press Apply to see a preview.
settings.personaInfoWithKey: The Apply button will call AI once to rewrite all app text according to the roles you entered.
settings.personaInfoNoKey: Without an AI key, persona stays active with built-in fallback based on recognized roles.
settings.addLocationHint: e.g. Small fridge, Pantry, Spice rack.

assistant.title: RumaQ Assistant
assistant.bringYourOwnKey: Bring your own AI key, e.g. OpenCode, so RumaQ can create plans and give recommendations.
assistant.keyMissing: AI key not configured. Add a key in Settings.
assistant.postPhotoDesc: Scan a receipt to update your stock

ui.ownKeyUnlimited: Unlimited — your own API key covers the usage.
ui.serverKeyRecorded: RumaQ's shared server key — usage is recorded, never capped.

offline.banner: You're offline — changes will sync when you reconnect

plugins.disabledDesc: This feature is off for your household. A household owner can turn it back on in Household admin.
plugins.catalogSubtitle: Built-in features for this household. Owners can turn each one on or off.
plugins.membersHint: Only household owners can change these.
plugins.deploymentOffHint: Paused for this deployment — an operator can turn it back on.
plugins.retentionNote: Data is kept while a feature is off — turning it back on brings everything back.
plugins.errorGeneric: Couldn't save that change. Please try again.

export.note: Documents and files download as a zip archive with their metadata. A large vault downloads as several parts — keep them all.
export.errorGeneric: Couldn’t download the archive. Please try again.

purge.dialogWarning: This permanently deletes every document and file this feature stores for this household — the stored bytes first, then the records. This cannot be undone.
purge.dialogDrainNote: Deletion runs in the background and can take a few nights for larger vaults. Uploads are paused until it finishes.
purge.statePending: Deletion requested — it runs overnight; uploads are paused until it finishes.
purge.stateRunning: Deletion in progress; uploads are paused until it finishes.
purge.errorGeneric: Couldn't start the deletion. Please try again.

persona.homeLead: A calmer kitchen starts with what you already have. Stock is tracked automatically from your receipts.
persona.inventoryLead: Browse and compare stock. Filter by storage location, automatically sorted by most urgent.
persona.planLeadNoKey: Connect an API key first, then AI will create a shopping plan from items running low.
persona.planLead: AI groups items by store into single trips. Check off what you've bought, the rest is tracked automatically.
persona.historyLead: Purchase records form the basis of remaining stock estimates. Compare prices and shopping rhythms here.
persona.receiptLead: Take a photo or upload a receipt. AI reads items, quantity, price, and store, then you confirm.
persona.settingsLead: Bring your own AI key, manage storage locations, and adjust display preferences.
persona.systemPrompt: You are RumaQ, a household inventory and shopping assistant. Answer clearly, concisely, and practically.
persona.roleInstructionBase: Imagine you are {{ai}} and the user is {{user}}. Your entire response must match that role.

review.lead: Candidate product matches the matcher flagged for human review.
review.whyReview: Review is triggered by a flag — an implausible price gap against the catalog's last price, an unresolved AI verifier, or a low-confidence category classification — not by the match confidence.
review.confidenceHint: How sure the matcher is that both sides are the same product — 100% means an exact name and unit match. Review is triggered by the flag, not by this score.
review.exportFailed: Export failed — check your session and try again.
review.decisionsNote: Decisions are recorded for future matcher improvements; they do not change current price data.
review.decisionRubric: Approve only when both sides are the same product — same brand, variant and size/pack. Price differences alone are fine to approve (promo, member vs non-member price). Reject when the size, variant, pack count or brand differs: they are different products.
review.emptyDesc: Candidate pairs will appear here after a run flags uncertain matches.
review.aiModeManualDesc: No AI calls — you decide every item yourself.
review.aiModeAssistDesc: The AI proposes a verdict with confidence and reason; you agree or disagree.
review.aiModeAutoDesc: The AI decides on its own when it is at least {{percent}}% confident; the rest waits for you.
review.aiModeFailed: Could not save the review mode — try again.
review.aiModeUnavailable: Could not load the AI review mode.
review.aiNotConfigured: AI is not configured — set a provider key in AI settings; manual review still works
review.aiAgreeHint: Applies the AI's verdict: approve when it says same, reject when it says different.
review.aiDisagreeHint: Applies the opposite decision and records that you disagreed with the AI.
review.aiTaxonomyExcluded: No AI verdict for a category flag — the AI only judges product identity. This one is yours to decide.

rename.title: Rename canonical product
rename.previewEmpty: Type a new name to preview the change.
rename.aliasesEmpty: No name variants recorded for this product.
rename.aliasDecisionHint: Approving a variant adds it to the canonical index; rejecting keeps it out. A decision is final.
rename.aliasRejectArmed: Confirm rejecting “{{name}}”? A rejection is final.
rename.aliasApproveSuccess: Approved “{{name}}” — the canonical index is now version {{version}}. The pipeline sees it on its next run.
rename.aliasRejectSuccess: Rejected “{{name}}” — the canonical index stays at version {{version}}.
rename.aliasAlreadyDecided: This alias was already decided ({{status}}) — the list has been refreshed.
rename.aliasErrorNotFound: This alias no longer exists — the list has been refreshed.
rename.aliasErrorGeneric: Could not record the alias decision. Try again.
rename.reasonPlaceholder: Why rename it? Kept in the audit trail.
rename.loadError: Could not load this product's identity.
rename.duplicateDesc: Choose a different name. Products cannot share a canonical name, and merging is not supported.
rename.similarDesc: Rename anyway only if this product is genuinely separate from the ones listed.
rename.staleDesc: Review the new values and submit again if the new name is still right.
rename.successBody: The canonical index is now version {{version}}. The pipeline picks up the new name on its next run.
rename.errorInvalid: That name was rejected — check the length and characters.
rename.revertConfirm: Revert this rename and restore “{{name}}”? The audit trail keeps both entries.
rename.revertStaleTitle: That rename is no longer the latest
rename.revertStaleDesc: The identity was refreshed. Check the current values before reverting anything.
rename.revertSuccessBody: The canonical name is {{name}} again. Canonical index version {{version}}.
rename.frozenPairNote: The match above keeps its frozen catalog label; only the canonical product name changes.

duplicates.title: Duplicate names
duplicates.desc: Canonical products that share a name (case-insensitive). Read-only — nothing is merged or renamed here.
duplicates.error: The duplicate-name report could not be loaded.
duplicates.truncated: Some duplicate groups or products are not listed — the report is not complete.
